device.name: IKEA Furniture Assembly IKEASawyer-v0 (Gym simulation, simulated)

facts.text: FurnitureGym is the Gym wrapper: its constructor builds the concrete environment with make_env(name, config) and copies the environment's observation_space and action_space
FurnitureGym.reset calls the wrapped environment's reset and returns the observation only, and FurnitureGym.step returns the wrapped (observation, reward, done, info) tuple

IKEASawyer-v0 is registered with entry_point furniture.env.furniture_gym:FurnitureGym and kwargs id IKEASawyer-v0, name FurnitureSawyerEnv, furniture_name swivel_chair_0700, background Industrial and port 1050
The action space is a Dict with one member named default, a Box of shape (dof,) bounded by low -1 and high 1 per element
For control_type ik the Sawyer dof is 3 + 3 + 1 + 1 for move, rotate, select and connect
When object_ob is enabled, object_ob is a Box of shape (3 + 4) * n_objects: position 3 and quaternion 4 per object
When robot_ob is enabled, the Sawyer ik observation space adds a Box of shape 3 + 4 + 3 + 3 + 2 for pos, quat, velp, velr and gripper
object_ob, object_ob_all and robot_ob default to True
The swivel_chair_0700 furniture model declares three bodies: 1_chair_base, 2_chair_column and 3_chair_seat
The furniture part count is len(self.mujoco_objects), the children of the loaded furniture XML
_get_obs concatenates each object's position and quaternion into object_ob
The Sawyer _get_obs builds robot_ob from gripper_qpos, eef_pos, eef_quat, eef_velp and eef_velr for a non-qpos observation
max_episode_steps defaults to 2000
_after_step marks the episode terminal when the episode length reaches max_episode_steps or the episode failed, and _step also marks success when all required parts are connected
The reward is success_reward + touch_reward + pick_reward + ctrl_penalty, and ctrl_penalty is -ctrl_penalty_coef times the sum of the squared actions
ctrl_penalty_coef defaults to 1e-3
control_freq defaults to 10
_do_simulation sets _model_timestep from sim.model.opt.timestep and _control_timestep from 1.0 / control_freq, then runs int(control_timestep / model_timestep) physics steps per environment step
The environment seeds its numpy RandomState with config.seed at construction, and reset draws the furniture placement randomness from that generator
config.seed defaults to 123
When config.unity is set the environment creates a UnityInterface for rendering
The prerequisites are Python 3.7, MuJoCo 2.0 and Unity 2018.4.23f1
setup.py install_requires lists gym, mujoco-py, numpy, scipy and the other upstream dependencies

determinism.notes: FurnitureGym.reset takes no seed (furniture/env/furniture_gym.py:52-57); the clone seeds its numpy RandomState with config.seed only at construction (furniture/env/furniture.py:72, default 123 at furniture/config/furniture.py:324), so cap.world.seed.v1 and the reset seed are recorded by the bridge but cannot reseed the wrapped environment.  The fake starts from a fixed placeholder state and repeats exactly, but it does not share a random stream with upstream.

gaps: the package serves an F0 kinematic stand-in, not the MuJoCo furniture-assembly environment: no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, weld/equality constraints, inverse kinematics, gripper or furniture placement are modelled, and the assembly reward and success flag are not computed

the fake returns the real low-dimensional observation lengths for the registered environment (object_ob 21 = (3 + 4) * 3 for the three swivel_chair_0700 bodies, robot_ob 15 = 3 + 4 + 3 + 3 + 2 for Sawyer ik) but every value is a placeholder; the camera_ob, depth_ob and segmentation_ob arrays are not returned because visual_ob defaults to False (furniture/config/furniture.py:248-252)
the fake accepts only the registered environment's 8-element Sawyer ik action (3 + 3 + 1 + 1, furniture_sawyer.py:60-64); the other agents, control types and action sizes are not served
the seed of cap.world.reset/cap.world.seed does not reach the wrapper: FurnitureGym.reset takes no seed (furniture_gym.py:52-57), so determinism.seed_control is 'none'

one cap.world.step.v1 tick is one environment step (one control period of 100 ms from control_freq 10, furniture/config/furniture.py:72 and furniture.py:2855); the MuJoCo physics timestep and the number of physics iterations per control step are not stated in the clone (base.xml:4), so only the control period is published
the wrapper's step returns a four-tuple and reports done as terminated (furniture/env/furniture_gym.py:59-65); the fake reaches done only at the 2000-step horizon and never succeeds
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, only commands advance the state
snapshot_restore is false: FurnitureGym exposes get_env_state but no set_state/get_state pair for the Gymnasium bridge
no Unity rendering and no MuJoCo viewer: the package exposes no cap.world.render.v1 and the UnityInterface path (furniture/env/furniture.py:174-182) was not run
the upstream MuJoCo/Unity stack was never installed or opened where the gate ran, so no trajectory was compared with it; no physical device is modelled and nothing was validated against hardware

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
